changes.2_incomplete_family: Holm is always computed over BOTH primary ranks {1,4}; a rank that is absent or not analyzable enters as p=1 (m=2), and every other primary verdict becomes 'INCOMPLETE FAMILY ...' (never PASS). Same for the secondary family (a VOID secondary rank counts as missing). p2b_analyze.finalize; regression test test_incomplete_holm_family_is_not_a_pass.
changes.3_secondary_screens: Secondary test now has its own screens: KO_CWONLY collapse (median option mass < 0.05) -> secondary VOID; every KO_CWRAND/KO_CWDER is norm/rank/hook-checked against CAND -> secondary VOID on mismatch; CW-control collapse -> flag + sensitivity rank test without them; secondary recovery CI computed on the SAME keys as the secondary rank test. Three VOID lists: shared (liveness arms, KO_IDENT) void both tests; primary-only (CAND collapse, primary family norm/rank, CAPOP replay, BASE_CAND hooks) and secondary-only (CWONLY, CW family incl. missing dirs) never void each other (review finding 10). Tests: collapsed CWONLY, CW controls at 5x norm, missing CW family.
changes.4_raw_norm_fitted_controls: DESCRIPTIVE: report the raw/CAND total-norm ratio of every DER/SHUF control (from fit meta) and, in the add-on job, a rank test of CAND vs DER (15) and vs SHUF (5) at their RAW fitted norms (opraw = exact inverse of the per-module rescale). The norm-matched primary family is unchanged.
changes.5_mean_gap_bias: DESCRIPTIVE key comparator: MEANBIAS = TRAIN-mean (clean - KO) codeword-row module-output gap per module (same 26 modules/layers as CAND; p2b_meanbias.py from the TRAIN fit captures; input-independent). Arms per codeword: KO_MEANBIAS (bias at every position), KO_CWMEANBIAS (bias at the codeword row only, matching CWONLY), BASE_MEANBIAS (clean prompt, damage). MEANBIAS is rank-independent: one set per codeword, compared with CAND at each primary rank. Reported: CAND - MEANBIAS and CWONLY - CWMEANBIAS (domain-paired, bootstrap CI). It is at its natural magnitude (not norm-matched; a constant bias has no rank/norm counterpart).
changes.wording_rule: A CAND (or CWONLY) PASS whose CAND - MEANBIAS (resp. CWONLY - CWMEANBIAS) CI includes 0 or is negative certifies ONLY 'writing (approximately) the mean KO->clean output shift undoes part of the knockout'. It may NOT be described as an input-conditional, semantic, or position-aware operator. 'Input-conditional' wording requires CAND - MEANBIAS CI-lo > 0 on VALIDATION (descriptive, not a preregistered pass).
changes.decide_guard: decide() returns CANNOT ANSWER if a recovery dict has status ok but no ci95 (review LOW).
